items.why: No single headline names AMD, but the AI sell-off headlines cover chip names, with stocks heading for their worst week since liberation day.
Volatility jumps as the S&P 500 and Dow enter correction and the Nasdaq wipes out its 2026 gain.
Nvidia slides as investors weigh CEO transition fallout despite strong Q3 results, and the post earnings slide keeps getting uglier by the day.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures are down 4.08% and S&P futures down 2.4% as the AI sell-off continues.
summary: Stocks are selling off hard, with the S&P 500 and Dow in correction and the Nasdaq wiping out its 2026 gain as the AI sell-off deepens. It is shaping up to be the worst week since liberation day.
